method: Both benchmark binaries were built in the same isolated four-crate workspace, first from the pinned commit, then after copying the listed candidate files. The identical pruned lockfile is retained; all package identities and registry checksums match the root lockfile. Removing unused workspace members prunes optional edges and disambiguating version text, so this is not the root workspace dependency graph.
lockfile_note: The first baseline build used --offline without --locked to prune the root lockfile for this isolated workspace; subsequent builds used the unchanged pruned lockfile with --locked.

initial_variant.reconstruction: Reconstructed from 546cd35fa plus the documented coverage-paragraph update applied before the initial candidate build. The other three candidate solver source files are identical between the initial and activity-flag variants.
